source: 710 “Communication”
target: 710 “Communicatio”

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised when his wrist was grabbed by the wet hand.
target: Lumian non mirabatur, cum manus umida carpus eius rapiebatur.

source: He even chuckled.
target: Etiam subridit.

source: “Not bad. You only stained my wrist, not corrupt my entire arm.”
target: “Non male. Solum carpus meum maculasti, non totum brachium meum corrumpis.”

source: As he spoke, he pulled back with all his might, feeling the abnormally heavy force opposing him.
target: Dum loquebatur, vi tota se retraxit, sentiens vim insolite gravem ei adversantem.

source: Lumian’s muscles swelled, and his body appeared to grow slightly larger.
target: Musculi Luminiani tumefierunt, et corpus eius paulum majus videbatur.

source: At last, he saw the bloody figure in the jacket being dragged out of the empty mirror.
target: Denique vidit sanguinolentam figuram in veste ex speculo vacuo trahebam.

source: A bluish-black mist materialized, permeating the faux goatskin containing the ominous contract.
target: Nebula caeruleo-nigra apparuit, diffundens in ficta cute caprina contractum ominosum inclusum.

source: The contract burst into flames on its own, morphing into silver-black symbols and words.
target: Contractum per se in flammas exarsit, transformans se in symbola et verba argentea nigra.

source: They linked together from end to end, creating an intricate and illusory pattern that abruptly passed through his clothes and settled between Lumian’s chest and abdomen.
target: Haec inter se connexa sunt ab extremo ad extremum, creantes consilium intricatum et illusorium quod subito per vestimenta eius transiit et inter pectus et venter Luminiani consedit.

source: Having pulled Bloody Jack out of the mirror, Lumian had fulfilled the other party’s request, and the contract was automatically fulfilled!
target: Bloody Jack ex speculo extracto, Lumian petitionem alterius partis explevit, et contractum per se adimpletum est!

source: At that instant, Bloody Jack, who had regained his footing in front of the altar, raised his head.
target: Illo momento, Bloody Jack, qui ante aram iterum stetit, caput attollit.

source: His mutilated face turned towards Lumian as he lifted the blood‐dripping axe with both hands.
target: Facies eius mutilata ad Lumian versa est, dum securim, sanguine stillantem, ambabus manibus levavit.

source: Lumian’s eyes, tinged with an iron-black hue, mirrored a two-toned figure of Bloody Jack.
target: Oculi Luminiani, ferro nigro tincti, imaginem bicolorem Bloody Jack repraesentaverunt.

source: One was a vivid red, enveloping every crevice of Bloody Jack’s body, permeating every inch of space.
target: Una erat rubra viva, quae omnes rimae corporis Bloody Jack involvit et omne spatium pervagans erat.

source: The other was a pale white, no larger than a thumb.
target: Altera erat pallida alba, non amplius quam pollex.

source: It was located at Bloody Jack’s abdomen, enveloped by layers of bright red.
target: Ea in venter Bloody Jack sita erat, circumdata stratis rubri nitidi.

source: Much like Padre Cali in his untransformed Wraith state, he has only one vulnerability from head to toe, but it’s not in his Spirit Body; it’s concealed within his physical form…
target: Sicut Padre Cali in suo statu Wraith non transformato, habet unam solam infirmitatem ab capite usque ad pedes, sed non in Corpori Spirituali; ea autem in forma physica abscondita est.

source: This seems to be composed of viscous blood.
target: Id videtur ex sanguine viscoso compositum esse.

source: Regardless of the extent of damage or blood loss it endures, as long as the core remains unharmed, it will be unaffected…
target: Quamvis quantum damni aut sanguinis amissione patiatur, dummodo nucleus intactus maneat, id immutatum erit.

source: It bears some resemblance to the Rose Bishop of the Secrets Suppliant pathway, but it possesses mirror-related capabilities…
target: Aliquantum similitudo recolitur ad Episcopum Rosae viae Secretorum Supplicantium, sed facultates speculo pertinentes posidet.

source: As Lumian observed, a succession of thoughts calmly raced through his mind.
target: Ut Lumian observavit, seriem cogitationum tranquille per mentem eius peragrabantur.

source: Bloody Jack’s red spiderweb-like eyes displayed a ruthless and bloodthirsty expression.
target: Oculi rubri, instar retis araneae, Bloody Jack vultum implacabilem et sanguinem appetentem ostenderunt.

source: He raised his axe and swung it at Lumian’s body.
target: Securim attollit et in corpus Luminiani percussit.

source: The deal is done. Now, I’m going to kill you!
target: Pactum consummatum est. Nunc te occidam!

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: The axe missed Lumian and hit the ground of the quarry cave, creating a deep fissure and sending gravel and dirt flying.
target: Securis Luminiani non contigit eum et terram speluncae fodinae percussit, fissuram profundam creans et lapillos atque terram proiciebans.

source: With a twisted flexibility that exceeded human limits, Lumian maneuvered behind Bloody Jack.
target: Cum flexibilitate tortuosa, quae limites humanis superabat, Lumian post Bloody Jack versabatur.

source: With a swift motion of his arm, Lumian punched out with his right fist.
target: Celeri bracchii motu, Lumian dextro pugno percussit.

source: Blazing white flames surged forth, a bright tail enveloping his fist and wrapping around his forearm.
target: Flammae albae ardentes exortae sunt, caudam nitidam pugnum eius involvens et antebrachium circumvolvens.

source: Pfft! Lumian’s fist felt as if it had plunged into a swamp. The deeper he went, the more muddy and sticky it became.
target: Pfft! Pugnus Luminiani videbatur quasi in paludem mergi; quoad altitudinem, eo limosior et adhaerentior fiebat.

source: Rumble! He detonated the blazing white flames surrounding his fist, blasting open a passageway.
target: Rumble! Flammae albae ardentes, quae pugnum eius circumdebant, displosae sunt, viam patefecerunt.

source: His fist and forearm sank into Bloody Jack’s cavity, halting at the pale-white spot.
target: Pugnus eius et antebrachium in cavitatem Bloody Jack ceciderunt, sistentes in loco pallide albo.

source: Just as Bloody Jack was about to turn around and swing his axe, he froze. His body rapidly disintegrated, turning into congealed blood that fell to the ground.
target: Ita, cum Bloody Jack conversurus esset et securim percussurus, immobilis factus est. Corpus eius celeriter dissolutum est, in sanguinem coagulum conversum, qui in terram cecidit.

source: The blood clots writhed and reassembled into Bloody Jack, but there was still a gap in his abdomen that couldn’t be filled.
target: Coagula sanguinis se contorquebantur et in Bloody Jack redintegrabantur, sed adhuc hiatus in ventre eius exstabat, quod impleri non poterat.

source: Seeing this, Lumian’s body ignited with a blazing white flame, ready to attack with all his might.
target: Videns hoc, corpus Luminiani ignem albidum ardentem accendit, paratum ad impetum maximae virium.

source: Bloody Jack instantly turned ethereal and retreated into the mirror on the altar.
target: Bloody Jack statim evanuit et in speculo ad aram recessit.

source: Lumian chuckled and abandoned the pursuit, ending the summoning ritual at a moderate pace.
target: Lumian subridens persecutionem deseruit et ritum evocandi ad modum finivit.

source: His objective had been achieved. He had acquired the contracted ability—Mirror Mark!
target: Propositum eius perfectum est. Contractam facultatem—Signum Speculi—acquivit!

source: Previously, he had observed Bloody Jack’s river of fate not to gather information about it, but to verify if this strange creature from the bloody world possessed godhood!
target: Prius observaverat flumen fati Bloody Jack non ad notitiae colligendas, sed ut comprobares num haec insolita creatura ex mundo sanguinoso deitatem haberet!

source: If Bloody Jack didn’t have godhood, Lumian could complete some risky transactions with him to circumvent the requirement of 99 living sacrifices. If Bloody Jack had godhood, he would undoubtedly suffer a backlash. However, he was protected by the ritual and under Mr. Fool’s gray fog’s supervision, so he wouldn’t be significantly affected.
target: Si Bloody Jack deitatem non haberet, Lumian cum eo negotia periculosa conficere posset, ut exigentiam XCIX sacrificiorum viventium circumveniret. Si autem deitatem haberet, certo iniuriam subiret. Attamen, rituale eum protegebat et sub vigilantia nebulae griseae Domini Folli erat, itaque non graviter affectus esset.

source: It was precisely because he was aware of this that Lumian dared to agree to drag Bloody Jack out of the mirror, allowing him to no longer be restricted by the ritual.
target: Idcirco, cum hoc conscius esset, Lumian ausus est consentire ut Bloody Jack ex speculo traheretur, ita ut amplius a rituali coercebarentur.

source: It turned out that as long as the contracted party could communicate normally, the price to pay when signing the contract would be significantly lower.
target: Evenit, dummodo pars contracta normaliter communicare valeat, pretium in contractum subscribendo signanter minorem futurum esse.

source: Of course, there was no way to avoid the negative effects entirely. Although Lumian obtained the Mirror Mark, it would also make him more susceptible to attracting abnormal events and strange dangers related to mirrors.
target: Certe, nullus modus erat effectus negativos omnino vitare. Etsi Lumian Signum Speculi obtinuit, id eum etiam proclivum faceret ad attrahendos eventus abnormes et pericula insolita speculis conexa.

source: As the crack created by Bloody Jack spread to the wall of spirituality, causing it to gradually disintegrate, Franca took the opportunity to curiously inquire about what had just transpired.
target: Cum fissura a Bloody Jack in parietem spiritualitatis diffundebatur, paulatim dissolvens eum, Franca occasionem cepit ad curiose interrogandum quid modo evenisset.

source: Lumian gave a brief account of his “negotiation” with Bloody Jack and smiled.
target: Lumian breviter exposuit de sua “negotiatione” cum Bloody Jack et subridens arriduit.

source: “I worked hard to reach Sequence 5 so that these evil creatures would be able to communicate with me calmly.”
target: “Laboravi ut ad Sequenciam 5 pervenirem, ut hae creaturae maleficae mecum tranquille communicare possent.”

source: Franca couldn’t resist laughing. “You call that calm?”
target: Franca se a ridendo continere non potuit. “Hoc tranquillum vocas?”

source: With a sigh, she said, “If it weren’t for dealing with Moran Avigny, the Mirror Mark wouldn’t be a wise choice. You wouldn’t have much use for it normally. It’s like wasting a contract slot.”
target: Suspirans, dixit, “Nisi negotia cum Moran Avigny, Signum Speculi non esset electio sapientissima. Normaliter parum utilitatis tibi afferet; quasi locum contractus terere.”

source: This was due to Lumian’s lack of mirror-related abilities. Without a fixed mirror world entrance, he couldn’t pass through mirrors, let alone use the Mirror Mark to locate his target.
target: Hoc propter defectum facultatum ad specula pertinentium Luminiani erat. Sine introitus fijo in mundo speculari, specula transire non poterat, nec Signum Speculi ad scopum detegendum adhibere.

source: Lumian wasn’t bothered by it.
target: Lumian id non curabat.

source: “The Sealed Artifact corresponding to the Hisoka Beyonder characteristic might have the ability to transform into a Wraith. The Mirror Mark could be used to complement it.”
target: “Artifactum Sigillatum, quod Hisoka Beyonder proprietati correspondet, fortasse facultatem habet in Wraith transformandi. Signum Speculi ad id complendum adhiberi posset.”

source: “Let’s hope that’s the case,” Franca said, sighing. “This is why Contractees can’t compare to Shepherds. Once you sign a contract and gain an ability, you’re stuck with it. Even if that ability becomes useless, it still takes up a slot and brings the associated negative effects.”
target: “Speremus ita esse,” inquit Franca, suspirans, “propterea Contracti cum Pastoribus comparari non possunt. Quoties contractum subscribis et facultatem acquiris, illud tibi constat; et, etsi illa facultas inutilis evadat, tamen locum occupat atque effectus negativos adfert.”

source: Many contracted abilities were acquired to fulfill specific needs for a limited time. After that period, they often became useless. For instance, Lumian’s Niese Face could only be used occasionally as an illusion during combat after he obtained the Lie earring.
target: Multae facultates contractae empta erant ad specificas necessitates in tempore finito explendas. Post illo tempus saepe inutiles fiebant. Exempli gratia, Vultus Niese Luminiani tantum aliquando uti poterat ut simulatio in proelio, postquam auriculam Mendacii acceperat.

source: Lumian smiled. “Who says I can’t get rid of it?”
target: Lumian subridet, “Quis dicit me id removere non posse?”

source: “Uh…” Franca was caught off guard.
target: “Heu…” Franca obstupefacta est.

source: Lumian’s lips curved into a bright smile.
target: Labia Luminiani in risu claro incurvata sunt.

source: “Kill the contract target, and the contract will automatically be nullified.”
target: “Occide scopus contracti, et contractus automatice rescindetur.”

source: Franca and Jenna gasped inwardly.
target: Franca et Jenna interne exclamaverunt.

source: After a moment, Franca joked, “Very good. Keep that smile. That’s the smile of a homicidal maniac—no, a Reaper.”
target: Post instantes, Franca iocose dixit, “Optime. Illud risum conserva. Est risus homicidarum insanus—immo, Messor.”

source: Jenna nodded thoughtfully. “No wonder you didn’t kill Bloody Jack just now and only scared it away. You were worried that the newly acquired abilities would vanish instantly. Didn’t you mention you were planning to contract three abilities this time? Have you thought about the other two?”
target: Jenna, mente cogitans, annuit: “Non mirum est quod nuper Bloody Jack non occidisti, sed solum territus recepisti. Timuisti enim ne nuper adeptae facultates instante evanescerent. Nonne dixisti te hoc tempore tres facultates contracturum esse? De reliquis duabus cogitaveris?”

source: “Yes.” Lumian wasn’t in a rush to complete the second ritual. He casually chatted, “One is to boost my defense or substitution abilities, while the other is to handle undead creatures. However, I’ll need to think about the latter later.”
target: “Ita,” respondit Lumian leniter, non festinans ad secundum ritum perficendum. “Una est ad defensionem meam vel substitutionis facultates augendas, altera est ad gerendas creaturas mortuas. Tamen de altera postea cogitare mihi erit.”

source: The former addressed his lack of physical defense, while the latter made up for his insufficient means to deal with Wraiths and undead creatures.
target: Primum defectum defensionis corporalis solvit, altera vero insufficientiam modorum ad tractandos Wraiths et creaturas mortuas compensat.

source: “Substitution abilities…” Franca said, smiling. “Just sign a contract with a Wraith or specter formed by a Demoness or a Mid-Sequence Seer Beyonder after their death.”
target: “Facultates substitutionis…” inquit Franca, subridens, “contractum subscribe cum Wraith aut speculato a Demonissa aut Medio-Sequentiae Seer Beyonder post mortem eorum formatus.”

source: Lumian scoffed.
target: Lumian irridens respondit.

source: “Do you think I haven’t considered that? However, apart from the Demoness evil spirit suspected to be a Saint, there’s nothing related to Demonesses or Seers. I definitely can’t handle the negative effects of a demigod contractor at my current level.”
target: “Putasne me id non considerasse? Attamen, nisi spiritus malignus Demonissa, qui Sanctus esse suspicatur, nihil aliud pertinet ad Demonissas aut Videntes. Certe effectus negativos contractoris semidei ad gradu meo non ferre possum.”

source: “Maybe it’s manageable,” Franca’s eyes sparkled. “Maybe the adverse effects will only change your gender.”
target: “Forsitan moderabitur,” oculi Francae scintillaverunt. “Forsitan effectus adversi tantum sexum tuum mutabunt.”

source: “What do you mean ‘only’?” Lumian wanted to tease Franca for her “life is short, why not give it a shot” mindset, but he restrained himself in front of Jenna.
target: “Quid significas ‘tantum’?” inquit Lumian, desiderans Francam provocare propter mentem “vita brevis est, cur non temptes?”, sed coram Jenna se continuit.

source: Franca suddenly had a thought. “Can you only sign contracts with spirit world creatures or strange creatures? Can you sign one with a human? I can share the Mirror Substitution ability with you.”
target: Franca repente cogitavit: “Num solum cum creaturis mundi spiritualis aut insolitis contracta scribere potes? An cum homine contractum facere licet? Tibi facultatem substitutionis speculi communicare possum.”

source: This was the first time Lumian had considered this question. After thinking for a moment, he said, “The relevant mysticism knowledge doesn’t forbid it… But never mind. The Inevitability contract might have some hidden corruption or influence.”
target: Hoc primum fuit quod Lumian hanc quaestionem consideravit. Post breve meditationem, inquit, “Scientia mystica ad rem pertinentia id non vetat… Sed nihil refert. Contractus Inevitabilitatis fortasse aliquam latentem corruptionem vel influentiam habeat.”

source: “That’s true.” Franca was still rational.
target: “Verum est,” inquit Franca, adhuc rationem servans.

source: As she responded, another question popped into her mind.
target: Dum respondebat, altera quaestio in mentem eius subito venit.

source: If I actually sign a contract with him, what kind of negative effects will I inflict on Lumian?
target: Si vere cum eo contractum subscribam, quos effectus negativos Lumiani infligam?

source: “Why does the ability to deal with the undead have to wait?” Jenna wasn’t as quick-witted as Franca, so she could only focus on more practical matters.
target: “Cur facultas ad tractandum cum mortuis exspectare debet?” inquit Jenna, quae non tam vivax erat quam Franca, atque solum rebus practicis inspicere potuit.

source: Lumian chuckled. “Because spirit world creatures and strange creatures fear sunlight’s purification and don’t have similar abilities, I can only consider obtaining it from the death domain. There’s a good contract target there.”
target: Lumian subridens dixit, “Quia creaturae mundi spiritualis et insolitae purificationem solis timent nec facultates similes habent, solum e dominio mortis id obtinere considerare possum. Ibi optimus scopus contractus invenitur.”

source: “Armored Shadow?” Franca realized. “Are you worried that giving him too much gold will make future communication uncontrollable?”
target: «Umbra Armata?» inquit Franca; «num tibi sollicitus es quod nimis aurum donando, futura communicatio incondita fiat?»

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “Additionally, I’m also waiting for the Sealed Artifact made from the Hisoka Beyonder characteristic. If it’s related to a Wraith, I won’t need the corresponding contract ability.”
target: Lumian annuit et respondit, “Praeterea, exspecto Artifactum Sigillatum, quod Hisoka Beyonder proprietati correspondit. Si ad Wraith referatur, non mihi opus erit facultiæ contractæ respondente.”

source: After chatting for a while, Lumian reconstructed the wall of spirituality and began his second summoning.
target: Post aliquod sermone, Lumian parietem spiritualitatis refecit et secundam evocationem incepit.

source: This time, he summoned: “A peculiar creature wandering above the world, an unimaginably sturdy being, a colossal creature that never rests.”
target: Hoc tempore, evocavit: “Creaturam pecularem, per orbem errantem, ens incredibiliter robustum, ingentem creaturam quae numquam quiescit.”

source: After reciting the incantation, a “peak” made of layers of flesh appeared at the mysterious door.
target: Post incantationem recitandam, culmen ex stratis carnis apparuit ad ianuam mysticam.

source: Its height was unknown, but it couldn’t fully emerge, causing the illusory and mysterious door to shake.
target: Altitudo eius incerta erat, sed omnino emergere non potuit, quod ianuam illusoriam et mysticam concutiebat.

source: After speaking the Mystical Language of Fate, Lumian obtained the corresponding information.
target: Postquam Linguam Mysticam Fati enuntiavit, Lumian informationem ad eam pertinentem obtinuit.

source: This “mountain of flesh” indeed possessed the ability to enhance one’s defense. It could toughen one’s body to be like steel or rock, but the corresponding downside was having a movement speed as slow as that of an ordinary turtle.
target: Hic “mons carnis” vere facultatem defensionis augendi habebat. Corpus in modum ferri vel saxi durari poterat, sed incommodum quidem erat motus tam tardus quam testudinis communis.

source: Lumian had no choice but to give up.
target: Lumian nihil aliud potuit facere quam cedere.

source: His alternative target was his messenger, Penitent Baynfel.
target: Scopus alternus eius erat nuntius, Penitent Baynfel.

source: According to the messenger information provided by Madam Magician, Baynfel had the ability to bring his shadow to life and switch positions with his body at critical moments.
target: Secundum informationes nuntii a Domina Magica traditas, Baynfel facultatem habebat umbram suam ad vitam revocandi et cum corpore suo in temporibus criticis locos permutandi.
